rule: Compose narrowly. Every added skill must own a distinct failure class or handoff obligation.

compositions.use_when: A non-trivial defect may be systemic and the resulting change must stay inside authority and merge scope.

sequence.role: bound objective, authority, scope, verification, and stop conditions
prove the mechanism and blast radius before patching
stop before crossing ungranted architectural or production authority
prove every resulting hunk belongs to the charter

compositions.handoff_contract: The root mechanism and authorized fix locus become evidence for the diff audit; later stages may not silently broaden the charter.
compositions.falsify: Remove any stage whose failure class is not actually present. If the workflow remains equally safe and legible, the composition was over-broad.

compositions.use_when: A human decision must survive a long-running or multi-agent workflow without being reopened or diluted.

sequence.role: record the authority boundary for the work
preserve the latest explicit human decision across handoffs
verify ongoing work still serves the settled objective

compositions.handoff_contract: Later agents inherit the newest valid human decision and may reopen it only with genuinely newer conflicting evidence.
compositions.falsify: Find a later authoritative decision or evidence that invalidates the carried-forward choice. Without it, re-asking is drift.

compositions.use_when: Imported financial records are structurally present but provenance, cash, transfers, basis, or economic coherence may be incomplete.

sequence.role: grade each source before it can become financial authority
classify and reconcile capital movements without sign-based guesses
prove internal movements are neutral at the portfolio boundary
test whether the resulting records can all be economically true
establish canonical cash and honest mirror state
gate only the analytics contaminated by unresolved books

compositions.handoff_contract: No downstream stage may upgrade the evidence grade of an upstream record. Unknown classifications remain unknown until resolved.
compositions.falsify: Show that every downstream analytic can be recomputed from authoritative records without unresolved cash, transfer, or ledger contradictions.

compositions.use_when: An agent is about to publish portfolio performance or benchmark claims from records that may contain flows or valuation gaps.

sequence.role: establish which valuations and flows are authoritative
separate external funding from internal movement and operating cash effects
select or withhold a valid return calculation
block publication when material prerequisite books remain unresolved

compositions.handoff_contract: Funding classification and valuation readiness are inputs to performance, never retroactively inferred from the desired return.
compositions.falsify: Recompute the reported return from the same authoritative valuation and flow evidence. If the result depends on unresolved classification, withhold it.

compositions.use_when: Historical financial records need correction and the economic effects must be known before mutation.

sequence.role: separate authoritative correction evidence from estimates or reconstruction
prove the current contradiction and affected domains
preview the complete economic delta before changing history
replay lots when disposal basis or realized P&L is affected
verify post-repair canonical cash consequences
reopen analytics only after affected books are ready

compositions.handoff_contract: Preview and commit must use the same economic rules and inputs; a correction may not be justified by the output it is intended to produce.
compositions.falsify: Prove the proposed repair is unnecessary or that preview and resulting economics diverge. Either result blocks mutation.

compositions.use_when: A financial model combines observed data, estimates, assumptions, and deterministic formulas before a consequential decision or publication.

sequence.role: label provenance and permitted downstream use
prevent uncertainty from becoming false certainty in conclusions
attack identities, units, bounds, directionality, and independent recomputation
block dependent outputs if required financial domains are not ready

compositions.handoff_contract: Model confidence cannot exceed the weakest material evidence layer, even when formulas are internally consistent.
compositions.falsify: Find a hard invariant violation, unsupported evidence upgrade, or unresolved prerequisite book. Any one is enough to withhold the claim.
